properties.name: stackmate.enabled
properties.description: Enables deterministic StackMate diagnostics. Set false for an inert starter.

properties.name: stackmate.application-packages
properties.description: Application package prefixes used to rank application-owned stack frames.

properties.name: stackmate.capture.mvc-unhandled
properties.description: Captures exceptions that escape the Servlet MVC filter boundary.

properties.name: stackmate.capture.selected-mdc-keys
properties.description: Bounded MDC keys copied as sanitized diagnostic context; values are never configured here.

properties.name: stackmate.diagnostics.maximum-cause-depth
properties.description: Maximum cause-chain depth copied into a diagnostic snapshot; allowed range is 1 to 64.

properties.name: stackmate.diagnostics.maximum-suppressed-exceptions
properties.description: Maximum suppressed exceptions copied per throwable; allowed range is 0 to 16.

properties.name: stackmate.diagnostics.maximum-stack-frames
properties.description: Maximum stack frames copied per throwable; allowed range is 0 to 256.

properties.name: stackmate.diagnostics.maximum-application-frames
properties.description: Maximum application frames rendered in a diagnosis; allowed range is 1 to 32.

properties.name: stackmate.diagnostics.maximum-message-length
properties.description: Maximum code points retained from each sanitized message; allowed range is 1 to 4096.

properties.name: stackmate.privacy.redact-values
properties.description: Additional literal values redacted after mandatory built-in secret and PII rules. Regular expressions are not accepted.

properties.name: stackmate.deduplication.enabled
properties.description: Enables bounded in-memory duplicate occurrence tracking.

properties.name: stackmate.deduplication.ttl
properties.description: Retention window for duplicate fingerprints; must be positive and no more than one day.

properties.name: stackmate.deduplication.maximum-entries
properties.description: Maximum retained fingerprint entries; allowed range is 1 to 10000.

properties.name: stackmate.console.enabled
properties.description: Enables StackMate-controlled diagnostic console output.

properties.name: stackmate.console.style
properties.description: Selects the BOX or COMPACT deterministic console layout.

properties.name: stackmate.console.maximum-width
properties.description: Maximum console layout width; allowed range is 60 to 200 characters.

properties.name: stackmate.console.show-application-trace
properties.description: Includes sanitized application-owned frames when real package matches exist.

properties.name: stackmate.console.show-technical-details
properties.description: Includes bounded deterministic technical evidence in console output.

properties.name: stackmate.console.show-cause-chain
properties.description: Includes the bounded sanitized cause chain in console output.

properties.name: stackmate.console.debug-logging
properties.description: Logs bounded StackMate internal failure classes without raw incident values.

properties.name: stackmate.export.enabled
properties.description: Enables optional local sanitized incident-bundle export; disabled by default.

properties.name: stackmate.export.directory
properties.description: Local directory for atomic sanitized incident bundles.

properties.name: stackmate.export.maximum-incidents
properties.description: Maximum recognized incident bundles retained in the export directory.

properties.name: stackmate.safety.allow-in-production
properties.description: Allows analysis when an active profile matches the configured production profile names.

properties.name: stackmate.safety.production-profiles
properties.description: Profile names treated as production by the convenience guard; this is not a security boundary.
